question: Which statement is CERTAIN in relation to the synthesis of proteins ?:

options.opa: In prokaryotic organisms protein synthesis begins with any amino acid whose start codon has an A as the first nucleotide of the triplet.
options.opb: Enzymes called aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases, covalently bind each amino acid with the appropriate tRNA.
options.opc: There is only one specific tRNA for each animo acid.
options.opd: The termination of the polypeptide chains is signaled by one of the 5 special termination codons in the RNA.
